description: Paid or public students. An item is student-visible only when its content_state is validated AND its publication_state is published (the intersection Spec 03 intends by 'published only').
Internal beta testers and trusted reviewers. Sees validated content whether or not it is published (Spec 03 'published + validated').

Operator, content QA, and engineering. All publication states plus validated, validated_candidate, and hold content; the only mode that includes hold/queue states (Spec 03 'published + validated + validated_candidate + holds').
Import process only. New imports before approval, i.e. pre-publication factory content states (Spec 03 'new imports before approval').
